title: hierochloe odorata subsp. hirta
intro: Hierochloe odorata subsp. hirta, commonly known as Sweet Grass, is a perennial grass native to Europe and Asia, characterized by its sweet, vanilla-like fragrance. This plant has been used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Sweet Grass include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Hierochloe odorata subsp. hirta include sesquiterpenes and other volatile compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
